type-system.twistDescription: Applied line height loosening at intensity 4: replaced all 'normal' lineHeight values with explicit numeric values then added +0.2, resulting in 1.6 for body/p/link, 1.55 for h2, 1.4 for button. Replaced Amatic SC with Figtree (Google Fonts CDN, rounded warm geometric). Replaced Pally-Regular/Medium/Bold (proprietary woff2) with Quicksand (rounded playful sans, Google Fonts CDN). Nunito confirmed Google Fonts. All woff2 @font-face blocks removed.

motion-system.twistDescription: Easing curve swap (intensity 3): all standalone 'ease' timing functions replaced with 'ease-in-out', and all 'ease-out' timing functions replaced with 'cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)' — a precision deceleration curve. No duration values or color values changed.

grid-system.twistDescription: Shifted the primary 768px flex-row breakpoint threshold up by +75px to 843px. Delays the transition from stacked single-column layout to horizontal flex row, extending the mobile-style presentation further up the viewport range.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Hero padding emphasis at intensity 4 (×1.5): paddingTop 36px→54px, paddingRight 32px→48px, paddingBottom 36px→54px, paddingLeft 32px→48px. Hero margin values and all other element spacing left unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Applied hover transition speed (more languid) at intensity 3: added +0.15s to all transition durations across buttons, links, and navigation. Button transitions 0.15s→0.30s; link and navigation transitions 0.4s→0.55s. All values within 0.05s–0.8s clamp range. No color values modified.

nav-system.twistDescription: Fix agent: selected osmo-supply nav (fontFamily: inherit, passes font availability check). Clean fixed transparent nav with centered logo and grid-expansion dropdown. Best harmonizes with assembled typography (Figtree/Nunito) and color system (transparent nav, black text on cream).
nav-system.note: Original agent 7 selected griting-formless (Inter font). Check C flagged Inter not in assembled typography. Fix agent replaced with osmo-supply which uses fontFamily: inherit.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Material shift (C) applied to the 'Color System and Visual Hierarchy' section. The paragraph was rewritten to ground each palette zone in a specific physical material analogy — unglazed ceramic, beeswax, cast iron, fired clay. concept_by_video.md generated with 3 video placements: hero-ambient.mp4 (10s), editorial-object-detail.mp4 (5s), lifestyle-interior-right.mp4 (5s).
